{{Youmay|the apartment that [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] lived in shortly after getting [[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa/Legends|married]]|the [[Solo apartment|apartment]] they lived in with their children during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]}}
The '''Solos' apartment''' served as the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] residence of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] shortly after their [[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa/Legends|wedding]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. It was situated in a building across from [[Sasal Center]], [[Wauth Complex]], and [[Ooe'b Towers]]. A door connected it to [[Chewbacca's quarters]]. A [[Rath|burglar]] broke into it in 8 ABY while the Solos were at [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] preparing for a state dinner.

The Solos later moved into the Imperial Palace.
